mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, category_id, type, amount, date, created_at FROM finance_record WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO finance_record (user_id, category_id, type, amount, date) VALUES (#{userId}, #{categoryId}, #{type}, #{amount}, #{date})
mapper.select: SELECT id, name, type, is_default FROM finance_category WHERE type = #{type} ORDER BY is_default DESC, id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO finance_category (name, type, is_default) VALUES (#{name}, #{type}, 0)
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM finance_category WHERE id = #{id} AND is_default = 0
